title: Root Chakra (Muladhara) - The Foundation
description: Grounding, Survival, Safety, and the Right to Be Here.

options.text: A softening or opening in my heart.
options.rationale: That is the Heart center. The Root grounds first; the Heart opens from that foundation.

options.text: Clarity or vision behind my eyes.
options.rationale: That is the Third Eye. Grounding happens below, in the body's foundation.

options.text: A buzzing or warmth in my throat.
options.rationale: That is the Throat. The Root anchors you in the lower body—feet, legs, base of spine.
